preferred_label: Так говорил Заратустра — перевод Ю. М. Антоновского, состояние издания 1900 года
notes: Antonovsky's exact 1911 preface identifies a 1900 Edition state in his translation lineage. Current RSL and RNL records now reconcile one exact Saint Petersburg 1900 Antonovsky Edition through a shared rc\1717107 control core, identical transaction value, and matching bibliography. RSL reports two remote holdings and RNL reports one current holding, 128/318. The current Lithuanian National Library record adds one remote holding, 1.40686, and agrees on title, translation responsibility, place, year, and 624-page main extent, but its [s.n.] and [3], XI description conflicts with the RSL/RNL typography and [4], XII description. None of the four holdings is a ToS Item. The Expression remains provisional, uncollated, and unreviewed because no source pages or bytes were acquired; no source text, separate responsibility or provision-activity claim, publisher identity, exemplar identity, textual equivalence, 1900-to-1898/1899 derivation, rights, or semantic claim is materialized.
